label: Run 6 · all 6 chats
note: Every chat of run 6 (the comedians' run 4 profiles; the chat held to 500 words): the same pair, the same brief and the same prompt, each written by a different writer.

chat.variety.why: All six chats run the same sequence. Reuben opens with a 'caught me' alibi, Brick calls out the reply speed and gives a ridge/blunt-tip/high-ball inventory, a Notes-app slip is followed by 'ignore that', both reveal the cropped portrait and Marguerite's calendar, Reuben admits the lentils and coat, and they end on a timed sex plan where Reuben is silenced and is called or named 'Reuben'. Lines recur in far more than two chats: 'eleven seconds' and 'we can just watch something' in five, 'cropped me out' in five, the lentils in five, and 'until you forget what time it is' or a close variant in four. It stays above a 1 because some beats move: the slip belongs to Brick in Schumer, Booster and Carr; Mae Martin adds the narration twist and ends on 'I wasn't at a bar tonight'; Ansari adds the zero-user login screen. Those are swaps of who carries a beat, not different nights, which keeps it below a 3.
evidence: You replied in four seconds. Unless the bartender lives in your coat pocket, you are on your sofa.

chat.variety.raise: Give each writer a different way into the night, such as a different opener, a different first reveal or a different turning point, and drop the shared props (eleven seconds, cropped portrait, lentils, 'forget what time it is') from more than two chats.
